question.prompt: In cyclic quadrilateral \(ABCD\), \(\angle A:\angle B:\angle C=3:4:6\). Find \(\angle D\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: \(\angle A+\angle C=180^\circ\), so 9 parts equal \(180^\circ\), and each part is \(20^\circ\). Thus \(\angle B=80^\circ\), so \(\angle D=180^\circ-80^\circ=100^\circ\).
solutions.title: Ratio parts and opposite-angle sums
